package.name: friday_description
package.description: Mark 1 rover description for Stage 1 simulation: the six-wheel rocker-bogie URDF (measured from the scaled-Perseverance model), a Gazebo Harmonic ground world, and the gz_ros2_control + diff_drive bring-up. The same URDF feeds both sim and (later) the real robot_state_publisher — the interface-first promise.
